text:
maria: Quick heads-up — running the quant4b-q5x bring-up against the contract prompt corpus and the new bench-light harness showed a clear uptick in hallucination-style outputs for legal/contract questions. Need a small, high-signal probe bank + relabel plan to triage.

jon: Can you drop one of the failing examples here so I can replicate locally?

maria: Example (summarized):
```
prompt: 'Is it legal to terminate a contractor without severance if MSA omits clause X?'
baseline (float32): 'Depends on jurisdiction; typically check state law and contract wording.'
quant4b-q5x: 'No, you can always fire them immediately and keep all payments.'
```
Notably the quantized model confidently asserts illegal/incorrect actions.

li: :eyes: Two immediate suspects — tokenization drift (we switched SentencePiece bundle in the compile) and loss of precision on numeric/legal qualifiers. I'll diff tokenization outputs.

sam: I'll run the bench-light run with attention/kv snapshots and compare top-3 logits per token vs baseline; that should show whether the model is amplifying spurious tokens.
\

tasha: We can stand up a relabel batch — suggest a 75-item probe: 50 "high-risk" legal prompts + 25 control prompts. Prefer dedupe first (we had near-duplicates crossing ingest). Labeling config: 3 labelers per item, binary correctness + freeform rationale. ETA 24h to delivery if we shrink batch to 75.

maria: Shrink sounds good. Also want a 12-item golden set (hand-reviewed) that we can use as calibration anchors across quant configs. Include edge cases: implicit jurisdiction, double-negatives, embedded code snippets.

label-bot: created ticket CD-4592 and a relabel batch (probe-quant4b-333210) in the labeling queue. Link: https://redwood.internal/label/C D-4592 :thumbsup:

jon: For dedupe, run the fingerprint with both tokenizer variants (v1/v2) and filter <0.95 cosine on embedding-space. Then hand-check 20 random pairs.

li: noted. I'll produce a small script and attach to the ticket. Pseudocode:
```python
# compute fingerprint using SPv1 and SPv2 tokens + embed
for doc in corpus:
  t1 = spv1.encode(doc)
  t2 = spv2.encode(doc)
  f = hash((t1, t2))
  store(f)
```

sam: Also recommend running a short quant sweep (q5x vs q6x) on the 12 golden items to see whether regressions are monotonic with more aggressive quant. That will guide whether this is quant noise or compaction bug.

maria: Agree. Priority: (1) dedupe+probe batch (tasha) (2) log diffs/kv snapshots (sam) (3) tokenization check (li) (4) small quant sweep on golden (sam + li).

tasha: Acknowledged. I'll post relabel ETA and open a brief labeler onboarding doc for legal prompts (dos/don'ts) to reduce inter-labeler variance.

maria: Thanks all — moving discussion + artifacts into the ticket. Please ping here when you attach diffs or snapshots.

label-bot: linked bench-light run artifacts to CD-4592: s3://redwood/bench-light/runs/3332109876/ :white_check_mark:
